#storage_token.title: Storage Token
#storage_token.description: Read-only Storage token for this project

options.tooltip: Leave empty to catalog the config's own (host) project via the forwarded token. Required for any other project: create a read-only Storage token in that project and paste it here.
Defaults to the project name resolved from the token.

objects.title: Objects
objects.description: Which object families to catalog from this project

options.tooltip: Catalog buckets; uncheck to skip this family entirely.
Catalog transformations; uncheck to skip this family entirely.

transformations.title: Only these transformations
transformations.description: Transformations to emit as pipelines (empty = all)

write_components.title: Components
write_components.description: Extractors, writers, and other component configurations

options.tooltip: Catalog non-transformation component configurations; uncheck to skip this family entirely.

components.title: Only these components
components.description: Components to emit as pipelines (empty = all)

options.tooltip: Covers non-transformation configurations, e.g. a MySQL extractor configuration lives here, not under Transformations.
Catalog flows; uncheck to skip this family entirely.

flows.title: Only these flows
flows.description: Flows to emit as pipelines (empty = all)

write_data_apps.title: Data Apps
write_data_apps.description: Catalog data apps as OpenMetadata dashboards

options.tooltip: Catalog data apps; uncheck to skip this family entirely.

data_apps.title: Only these data apps
data_apps.description: Data apps to catalog as dashboards (empty = all)

options.tooltip: Each data app becomes a Dashboard entity (keboola.data-apps) with upstream table lineage from its input mapping.

write_bucket_lineage.title: Bucket lineage
write_bucket_lineage.description: Emit lineage between buckets, aggregated from table lineage

options.tooltip: Enabled by default.

write_table_lineage.title: Table lineage
write_table_lineage.description: Emit table-to-table lineage from input/output mappings and transformation SQL

options.tooltip: Enabled by default.

write_column_lineage.title: Column lineage
write_column_lineage.description: Emit column-level lineage from transformation SQL

options.tooltip: Enabled by default.

write_pipeline_lineage.title: Pipeline lineage
write_pipeline_lineage.description: Show the producing pipeline on each table lineage edge, and flow-to-task lineage

options.tooltip: Enabled by default. OpenMetadata shows the pipeline on the edge between the input and output tables, so column lineage stays visible.

write_dashboard_lineage.title: Dashboard lineage
write_dashboard_lineage.description: Emit dashboard lineage from data app input mappings

options.tooltip: Enabled by default.

pipeline_lineage_as_node.title: Pipeline as lineage node (legacy)
pipeline_lineage_as_node.description: Also draw each pipeline as its own node between the tables (table → pipeline → table)

options.tooltip: Disabled by default. The extra node edges clutter the lineage graph and OpenMetadata does not draw column lineage through them.

write_pipeline_status.title: Write Pipeline Status
write_pipeline_status.description: Emit each pipeline's run history (last job status)

options.tooltip: Enabled by default. Applies to the pipeline entities this row emits from Configurations and Flows.

full_refresh.title: Full Refresh
full_refresh.description: Ignore the change checks and re-push every bucket and lineage edge this run

options.tooltip: Disabled by default: a run skips the buckets and lineage that did not change since the last run. Every 20th run re-pushes everything anyway.

merge_mode.title: Merge Mode
merge_mode.description: How to reconcile OpenMetadata edits with Keboola-sourced values

options.tooltip: Three-way merge: the writer remembers what it wrote last time. A field that a person changed in OpenMetadata since then (for example a description) is kept, and the run report marks it 'skipped_diverged'. Keboola overwrites: Keboola is the source of truth, and every field the writer owns is overwritten on each run.

failure_mode.title: Failure Mode
failure_mode.description: How entity failures affect the job outcome

options.tooltip: Collect and fail at end records every per-entity failure in the run report and fails the job once all entities are processed. Fail fast stops on the first failure. Log only never fails the job.

parallel_requests.title: Parallel Requests
parallel_requests.description: How many OpenMetadata and Storage requests run at the same time

options.tooltip: 8 by default. Lower it if the OpenMetadata server is slow or overloaded; 1 sends one request at a time.
